changelog: Added option to show download details in Seerr search cards
description: The best way to discover and request Movies and TV shows and track request status through Seerr directly in Jellyfin.
name: SeerrFin
overview: Browse the Movies and TV Shows tabs or search Jellyfin for a missing title. Request a movie or specific seasons, then open the Requests tab to check approval, availability, and download progress when Radarr or Sonarr is connected.
